'''Dav al'Thone''' is an Emond's Field man from the [[Two Rivers]].

== Activities ==
Dav is on guard duty with [[Ban al'Seen]] at [[Tam]]'s tent, when [[Rand]] visits him for the last time before his strike on [[Shayol Ghul]] and his certain death. Rand assures them how important their task is, since they watch over his father. {{Ref/book|14|15}}
